validity.researcher_notes: Gulf Coast Express Pipeline is a real, operational Permian-to-Gulf Coast transmission system. Existence confirmed via Yahoo Finance (in-service Sept 2019), EIA historical data, SEC filings by DCP Midstream and Altus Midstream (operators/partners), trade press (OGJ, RBN, Hart), FERC records. All specs verified against >=2 independent sources: length 497.5 mi, diameter 36 and 42 in, capacity 1980 MMcf/d, in-service 2019, cost $1750M. Pipeline is jointly owned by Kinder Morgan (34% operating stake via KM Texas Pipeline subsidiary), DCP Midstream, Targa Resources, and Altus Midstream. Currently operating and subject to an expansion (Gulf Coast Express Expansion, separate project, 570 MMcf/d additional capacity, status Completed as of Aug 2026 per EIA). No existence, classification, or duplicate concerns identified. Caveat: several existing refs (EIA data.php, FracTracker, Kinder Morgan IR) are general navigation pages or lack clear pipeline name attribution; all replacements verified with explicit source verification.
